remarks: Completely renovated and updated charming four bedroom three full bath cape on a popular street close to town and Mead Park. Stunning eat-in kitchen with island and top of the line appliances opens to family room and has access to slate terrace and fenced in yard. Washer/dryer off mud room on the first floor. First floor bedroom with full bath perfect for office or guest room. Primary suite with full bath and walk-in closet. Additional 520 square feet in lower level has large finished space for playroom, exercise room or office. Loads of storage in basement. Landlord pays for lawn maintenance. Light filled and not your ordinary rental! You will feel right at home. Prime location and walking distance to village, train, new library and all the fabulous shops and restaurants in New Canaan.
